One area I enjoy most is improving software quality through structured testing with clear ownership. I am applied for this role because I want to strengthen my technical foundation in real production environment and grow into professional who combines problems solving with contest execution. At the same time I actively working on answering under pressure so I can present my ideas more effectively in professional discussions.
